# function: entityresolution_provider_service

Builds the ARN for `entityresolution` `ProviderService`:

```
arn:${Partition}:entityresolution:${Region}:${Account}:providerservice/${ProviderName}/${ProviderServiceName}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:entityresolution:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:providerservice/provider-name/provider-service-name
output "entityresolution_provider_service" {
  value = provider::arn::entityresolution_provider_service("provider-name", "provider-service-name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
entityresolution_provider_service(provider_name string, provider_service_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `provider_name` (String) Value for `${ProviderName}` in the ARN template.
1. `provider_service_name` (String) Value for `${ProviderServiceName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
